lines.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm of Asaph.
Hear us, O Shepherd of Israel,
who leads Joseph like a flock;
You who sit enthroned between the cherubim,
shine forth before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh.
Rally Your mighty power
and come to save us.
Restore us, O God,
and cause Your face to shine upon us,
that we may be saved.
O LORD God of Hosts,
how long will Your anger smolder
against the prayers of Your people?
You fed them with the bread of tears
and made them drink the full measure of their tears.
You make us contend with our neighbors;
our enemies mock us.
Restore us, O God of Hosts,
and cause Your face to shine upon us,
that we may be saved.

pictures.scene: Cornelis Albert van Assendelft, Herder met schapen — the shepherd standing among his flock in the open field, to the tune of The Lilies of the Covenant a Psalm of Asaph, hear us O Shepherd of Israel
pictures.name: pd_assendelft_herder_met_schapen

pictures.scene: Cimabue, Maestà du Louvre — the throne lifted up by the winged ones on either side, who leads Joseph like a flock, You who sit enthroned between the cherubim
pictures.name: pd_cimabue_maesta_louvre

pictures.scene: Jean-Victor Bertin, Paysage. Le matin — the first light coming over the country at morning, shine forth before Ephraim Benjamin and Manasseh
pictures.name: pd_bertin_paysage_le_matin

pictures.scene: Otto van Veen, The Famished People after the Relief of the Siege of Leiden — the starving city given bread the day the relief came, rally Your mighty power and come to save us
pictures.name: pd_veen_ontzet_leiden

pictures.scene: Joseph Wright of Derby, A Philosopher Lecturing on the Orrery — every face in the dark room turned toward the one light at its centre, restore us O God and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved
pictures.name: pd_wright_orrery

pictures.scene: Willem Roelofs, Landschap bij naderend onweer — the black weather building over the flat land before it breaks, O LORD God of Hosts how long will Your anger smolder
pictures.name: pd_roelofs_naderend_onweer

pictures.scene: Fernand Pelez, Sans asile — the mother and her children sitting out on the pavement with nowhere to go, against the prayers of Your people, You fed them with the bread of tears
pictures.name: pd_pelez_sans_asile

pictures.scene: Adriaen Brouwer, Fighting Peasants — the neighbours at each other's throats over the overturned table, and made them drink the full measure of their tears, You make us contend with our neighbors
pictures.name: pd_brouwer_fighting_peasants

pictures.scene: Édouard Manet, Jesus Mocked by the Soldiers — the Lord seated in the middle of the men who are making sport of Him, our enemies mock us, restore us O God of Hosts
pictures.name: pd_manet_jesus_mocked

pictures.scene: Worthington Whittredge, Foothills Colorado — the long hills opened out under a clear sky, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved
pictures.name: pd_whittredge_foothills_colorado
